items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: Breadcrumb is 'Contracts / Đông Á infrastructure services' (li aria-current), ending with the contract title, not CT-2026-0187. Header otherwise fine: 'CT-2026-0187 · Vendor Công ty TNHH ...', badge 'Active · expires in 56 days', four dl fields (Total value, Term, Expires, Contract owner).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btnRenew 'Start renewal' is the only filled button; #btnMore (aria-haspopup=menu) holds Edit terms, Create amendment, Export PDF, Terminate contract….

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: renderContacts: name, role columns; href="mailto:${c.email}", href="tel:..."; badge('Primary','info') for primary contact.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Columns Due date, Amount (VND) with 'text-right tabular-nums', Intl.NumberFormat vi-VN VND; milestoneInfo groups overdue(0), due soon(1), later(1.5), paid last; milestonesSorted = [...unpaid, ...paid].

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: badge labels `Overdue ${-d} days` and `Due in ${d} days` with text, plus header count '1 overdue'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: kvExpiry: '31/12/2026 (in 56 days)'; badge 'Active · expires in 56 days'; Renewal tab shows notice deadline absolute date with '(in N days)'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: Table has ID, Title, Date (dd/mm/yyyy absolute), value change, Status, 'Created by' column. The person column is labelled Created by, not approver; pending AM-03 has no approver shown (only a footnote naming the waiting approver). Approvers appear only in Activity log.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: ?state=empty gives empty('...','Add contact'/'Add milestone'/'Create amendment'); skeleton(5) for loading/booting; errorBox with role=alert and #retry button rendered in the panel per tab. Caveats: states are URL-driven for the whole panel, Activity empty has no action, Retry reloads the page.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: openDlg title 'Terminate contract CT-2026-0187?', body names vendor, unpaid milestones cancelled, early-termination fee, cannot be undone; ok:'Terminate contract'; focus goes to input #confirmName (type-to-confirm), not the red button.

notes: Clean, restrained admin UI; audit score 100 and no template tells found (no gradients except skeleton shimmer, no KPI tiles, no greeting, radii 4-6px, avatars are real people). Fails: breadcrumb ends with contract title not number; amendments show creator not approver.
